issues.title: Site 2 of 3: the status band
issues.body:
A band under the header showing where the team is: each build step with its state and date, and a line saying whether a red issue is open. Take every fact from `docs/status.md`; where the mockup's facts have moved on, use the current ones there. On a wide screen the head sits in a column beside the four steps.

Tests: every step is present with a state and a date.

Holds for every site issue: every claim on the page is true on the day this merges, using the facts in `docs/status.md`; it reads at 390 px and at 1440 px.

## Technical decisions
None: markup and CSS inside the existing page.
